response.body:
• I switched to a mechanical keyboard three weeks ago after a decade of laptop keyboards.
  • The first thing I noticed was the sound, and my partner noticed it too, immediately.
  • By the second week the typos had dropped off noticeably.
  • I don't know if I'd recommend the switch to everyone.
